comment: The fixture s19_library of tiaconv (TIA Portal V21, CPU 1511-1 PN): the FB Lib, called by Main, runs MOVE_BLK, FILL_BLK, FIND, REPLACE, INSERT, DELETE, STRG_VAL, VAL_STRG and Chars_TO_Strg on the members of LibData every cycle (Serialize, Deserialize, MB_SERVER, MB_CLIENT and TSEND_C are not simulated). P of STRG_VAL and VAL_STRG is LibData.p, which the program never sets back: each cycle goes on where the last left off. The values are worked out by hand from the code and DEVELOPMENT.md.
